history.summary: A 1,733 sqft freehold 4BR near Woodleigh MRT (700m) at $2.99M and $1,724 psf — but that asking PSF is ~11% ABOVE the $1,551 project median, and the unit sits at the >$3M illiquidity threshold. Strong 7.94% appreciation, but on a thin 40-txn series, and the listing is off the value frontier.
history.rating_rationale: This is the overpriced entry of the batch: $1,724 psf is ~11% above the $1,551 median, score_1000 is a weak 593, and it is NOT on the frontier — the only such listing here. $2.99M parks it at the top of the >$3M zone where the 4BR buyer pool is thinnest. The 7.94% CAGR looks attractive but rests on only 40 transactions (below the 50-txn reliability floor), so it is not dependable. Paying an above-median premium for an illiquid high-quantum 4BR on an unreliable appreciation figure is a clear no-buy on investment grounds, freehold notwithstanding.

history.summary: Freehold D19 1BR (506sqft) at Bartley Road priced ABOVE its own recent market. The algo's 750 score is propped up by a 7.94% trailing CAGR that has ~0 forward power, while the unit is genuinely dear vs comparables.
history.rating_rationale: Recent 12-month transactions at The Quinn average ~$1,587 psf (range $1,530-1,694), yet this unit asks $1,729 psf — roughly 9% above the market it trades in, corroborated by the dossier's +11.5% psf_premium_vs_cohort (7 txns) and the psf_above_market red flag. Freehold and a tidy 506sqft 1BR in D19 (a solid OCR forward region) are positives, but value leads the v3.4 prior and here value is negative: you are paying a premium, not a discount. The 7.94% appreciation_pct (40 txns) is a story, not a forward edge. Net: a livable small freehold unit but no margin of safety at this ask.
red_flags: Asking $1,729 psf is ~9% above the project's ~$1,587 psf recent average (psf_above_market)
+11.5% psf_premium_vs_cohort on thin 7-txn cohort still points the wrong way (overpriced)
High score_1000 (750) is largely a function of trailing 7.94% CAGR, which v3.4 backtest shows has no forward power
catalysts: Bartley/Woodleigh area, walkable to Woodleigh NE/Bartley CC MRT and NEX
Small absolute quantum (~$875k) keeps liquidity reasonable
